question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

She has no __desire__ for money.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4) **"Wish".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context she has no interest or wish for money.
 
• **Desire**: (इच्छा) - A strong feeling of wanting to have something or wishing for something to happen.
 
 
• **Example**: She has no desire for money.
 
 
 
• **Wish**: (इच्छा) - A desire or hope for something to happen.
 
 
• **Example**: His only wish was to see his daughter happy.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct meaning of "**desire**" in this context is **"Wish".**

Therefore, the correct answer is "Wish".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Disgust: (घृणा) - A strong feeling of disapproval or revulsion.
 
• Despise: (तिरस्कार करना) - Feel contempt or a deep repugnance for.
 
• Care: (परवाह करना) - Feel concern or interest; attach importance to something.
